title: Phase 15: Cinematic Vox Visual Journalism Storyboard

creative_system.system_a_company_art: Official Paper Diorama Prompt System (halftone B&W cutouts, white keylines, offset red strokes, archival palette)
creative_system.system_b_vox_grammar: Narration-driven visual journalism (every sentence has a visual argument, transformation, 2.5D depth)
creative_system.system_c_research_story: Grounding in Meta ads research, retail trader ICP pain points, and verified proprietary data

scenes.narration: At 2:17 AM, a lone trader sits in the dark. The screen flashes red.
scenes.visual_argument: A solitary trader isolated in a dark void while market monitors flash alert warnings.
scenes.visual_metaphor: A solitary human island surrounded by an ocean of nocturnal market volatility.
scenes.background: Muted archival newsprint grid, charcoal parchment texture, double keyline border.
scenes.midground: B&W halftone cutout trader at workstation, rough white keyline, offset red marker shadow.
scenes.foreground: Giant bold condensed numerals '2:17 AM' stamping into frame with ALERT_WASH and offset red stroke.
scenes.camera_move: slow creeping push-in on trader's eyes
scenes.depth: Front numeral plane at Z: +200px, trader subject at Z: 0px, archival newsprint wall at Z: -400px.
scenes.transition_in: Hard cut from black void with immediate audio sub-bass punch.
scenes.transformation: The flashing red numeral colon ':' pulses and transforms into the blinking cursor of a live newsfeed terminal.
scenes.transition_out: Match-cut on monitor cursor into cascading headline layers.

scenes.narration: Traders don't have an information problem. They are drowning in fourteen thousand alerts a minute.
scenes.visual_argument: Information physically overwhelms the trader, stacking endless layers of text, charts, and news clips until the screen is choked with noise.
scenes.visual_metaphor: A suffocating blizzard of financial paperwork burying the trader.
scenes.background: Cascading financial newsprint columns, tape strips, and microfiche overlays.
scenes.midground: B&W halftone trader cutout physically shrinking in scale as stacks of alert cards spring pop-up with overshoot.
scenes.foreground: Flying red warning triangles, broken trendlines, and newsprint fragments crossing close to the lens.
scenes.camera_move: fast lateral track then hard stop with overshoot
scenes.depth: Extreme shallow DOF: flying foreground debris Z: +350px, trader midground Z: 0px, 4-tier newsprint backdrop Z: -600px.
scenes.transition_in: Match-cut on cursor expanding into flying data cards.
scenes.transformation: Newspaper headline 'BREAKING MARKET COLLAPSE' tears down the middle (TEAR), the torn edge becoming a jagged red trendline.

scenes.narration: They have a signal problem. When every feed screams panic, where is the truth?
scenes.visual_argument: All conflicting arrows, charts, and headlines suddenly collapse toward one central point of focus, exposing the emptiness of the noise.
scenes.visual_metaphor: Noise collapsing into a singular gravity well.
scenes.background: Flat archival tan canvas with faint faded coordinate lines.
scenes.midground: Conflicting red and mustard directional arrows vibrating and canceling each other out, collapsing into center.
scenes.foreground: Bold condensed typography 'NOT ENOUGH SIGNAL', stamped red underline swipe.
scenes.depth: Flat multi-plane parallax: foreground text Z: +120px, midground arrows Z: 0px, background grid Z: -250px.
scenes.transition_in: Sudden inward contraction of surrounding noise cards.
scenes.transformation: Red marker underline pulls tight like a thread (THREAD_PULL) and snaps into a horizontal baseline coordinate on a global map.
scenes.transition_out: Baseline coordinate expands into latitude/longitude grid.
sound_events: room tone falling to near silence

scenes.narration: CrowdWisdom doesn't guess. It indexes 1,482,930 trader inputs in real time across the globe.
scenes.visual_argument: Hundreds of individual trader cutouts light up across a tactile paper map, each feeding a red signal thread into a central convergence hub.
scenes.visual_metaphor: Thousands of human whispers aggregating into a single resounding voice.
scenes.background: Archival aged topographic map of global financial capitals with textured paper grain.
scenes.midground: Multiple B&W halftone cutouts of traders across Tokyo, London, and New York, linked by glowing red vector lines.
scenes.foreground: Giant stat counter '1,482,930' ticking up aggressively with spring pop-up overshoot (TICK_UP).
scenes.depth: 3D diorama Z-depth: giant numerals Z: +250px, trader cutouts at varying depths Z: -100px to +50px, map terrain Z: -500px.
scenes.transition_in: Camera dives through the paper map surface as nodes illuminate.
scenes.transformation: The last digit '0' of 1,482,930 expands outward into a circular radar scope.
scenes.transition_out: Radar sweep reveals comparative benchmark cards.

scenes.narration: Delivering 68.4% directional accuracy—tested, verified, and proven across four hundred twenty-eight tickers.
scenes.visual_argument: A giant dual-card statistical proof stage comparing CrowdWisdom's 68.4% accuracy directly against market noise.
scenes.visual_metaphor: A precision balance scale locking into undeniable equilibrium.
scenes.background: Locked archival parchment canvas with faint microfiche grid and double border keyline.
scenes.midground: Stat card '68.4%' stamping down (STAMP) with an offset red marker keyline, beside ticker tags.
scenes.foreground: Bold black condensed headline 'DIRECTIONAL ACCURACY' with a mustard annotation label.
scenes.depth: Locked stage depth: headline label Z: +150px, stat cards Z: 0px, archival backdrop Z: -300px.
scenes.transition_in: Heavy physical stamp landing from above.
scenes.transformation: The decimal point in '68.4%' pulses, extruding a horizontal timeline ruler into the next scene.
scenes.transition_out: Timeline ruler extends laterally across frame.

scenes.narration: With a 14.6 hours early warning lead. That means seeing the institutional pivot before the candlestick breaks.
scenes.visual_argument: A clock hand sweeps across a split candlestick chart, highlighting the 14.6-hour gap between crowd sentiment shift and price collapse.
scenes.visual_metaphor: Seeing the thunderclap long before the rain falls.
scenes.background: Archival tan grid with 24-hour horizontal timeline ruler.
scenes.midground: Candlestick chart layer where price collapse occurs 14.6 hours after the red sentiment vector triggers.
scenes.foreground: Giant stat '14.6 HOURS' popping in with an ALERT_WASH and red underline swipe.
scenes.camera_move: ride a path like a rail
scenes.depth: Multi-layer parallax: foreground stat and clock hand Z: +180px, chart midground Z: 0px, timeline ruler Z: -200px.
scenes.transition_in: Timeline ruler glides seamlessly from decimal point extrusion.
scenes.transformation: The 14.6-hour sentiment divergence arrow pivots 90 degrees to form the crosshair of the CrowdWisdom platform.
scenes.transition_out: Crosshair zooms into center of trading interface.

scenes.narration: From noise, to signal, to execution. You stop trading in the dark.
scenes.visual_argument: The solitary trader from 2:17 AM reappears, but now the chaotic red screens are replaced by clean, golden CrowdWisdom intelligence vectors.
scenes.visual_metaphor: The dark room filling with morning clarity.
scenes.background: Deep layered diorama of the trading room now illuminated by warm archival light and calm grid.
scenes.midground: The trader cutout, steady and calm, pressing execution with complete conviction.
scenes.foreground: Floating editorial tags '+ALPHA', 'CONFIRMED SIGNAL', and gold convergence vector.
scenes.depth: Deep 3D space: floating +ALPHA tags Z: +220px, steady trader subject Z: 0px, warm archival room background Z: -450px.
scenes.transition_in: Match-cut on crosshair centering onto trader's monitor.
scenes.transformation: The execution button transforms into the CrowdWisdom brand seal.
scenes.transition_out: Smooth push through into brand lockup.

scenes.narration: CrowdWisdom Trading. See the signal inside the noise. Get access at crowdwisdomtrading.com.
scenes.visual_argument: Brand lockup stage with authoritative typography, verified metrics seal, and website destination.
scenes.visual_metaphor: The definitive institutional seal of truth.
scenes.background: Authoritative archival tan backdrop with subtle double keyline border and corner crosshairs.
scenes.midground: Bold condensed typography 'CROWDWISDOM TRADING', offset red underline, 'crowdwisdomtrading.com'.
scenes.foreground: Stamped verified badge: '1.48M+ INPUTS • 68.4% ACCURACY • 14.6H LEAD'.
scenes.depth: Locked architectural framing: verified badge Z: +100px, brand lockup Z: 0px, archival wall Z: -200px.
scenes.transition_in: Final brand seal settles with crisp tactile snap.
scenes.transformation: Settle with subtle red keyline pulse (ALERT_WASH).
scenes.transition_out: Fade out to archival tan freeze frame.
approved_text: SEE THE SIGNAL INSIDE THE NOISE
